items.summary: Generate a new Twin Roots Foods logo PNG that is different but visually similar to the user-uploaded reference (image-3.png): keep a circular layout, spice/ingredient line-art elements, earthy color palette, and include the exact text “Twin Roots Foods” and curved tagline text “Rooted in Purity”, but make the overall emblem more detailed. Save it as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated/ and do not serve it via the backend.
Update the site header logo image to use the newly generated logo asset instead of the current /assets/generated/logo-v4.dim_512x512.png.
Add a footer logo image (using the same newly generated logo asset) in the footer branding area near the “Twin Roots Foods” text so the footer has a logo to animate as requested.

Implement a noticeable bounce animation for the logo on both the header and footer: the bounce must play when the user visits/loads a page and also when navigating between internal pages (i.e., on route changes).
